# Vendored GPUNetIO Source

This directory contains a vendored copy of
[GPUNetIO](https://github.com/NVIDIA-DOCA/gpunetio).

Please do not submit NVSHMEM pull requests that modify this directory.
Submit bug reports, feature requests, and code contributions to the
[GPUNetIO upstream repository](https://github.com/NVIDIA-DOCA/gpunetio)
instead.

NVSHMEM periodically imports upstream releases. The exact source repository
and imported commit are recorded in [`VERSION`](VERSION).
